subject: Recap + proposed demo slots and evaluation kickoff materials
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@novamed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed demo slots and evaluation kickoff materials
Attachments: trial-plan-template.xlsx, prompt-set-sample.md

Hi Sita / Liam —

Thanks again for the chat earlier — appreciate the time and the clear description of NovaMed’s ingestion cadence and the two pilot use cases (clinical note normalization + payer eligibility summarization). Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can lock in an evaluation kickoff:

Recap (high level)
- Goal: validate Redwood-powered summarization + extraction on NovaMed clinical notes to reduce downstream triage time by 30–40%
- Success signals: precision/recall thresholds on key entities, end-to-end latency under 350ms median for single-document queries, and qualitative reviewer score >= 4/5 on summary usefulness
- Data: you mentioned 200–500 representative notes for initial prompt/eval set (PHI will remain on your side until we arrange a secure ingress)

Proposed next step: 45-minute evaluation kickoff / demo (agenda below). Please pick a slot that works for you, or send two alternatives and we’ll prioritize. All times shown in Eastern Time (ET):
- Tue, Oct 27 — 11:00–11:45am ET
- Tue, Oct 27 — 2:00–2:45pm ET
- Wed, Oct 28 — 9:00–9:45am ET

Agenda (45m)
1) 10m — brief contextual recap and success criteria alignment (Sita)
2) 20m — technical deep dive + demo (Ben)
3) 10m — trial plan & roll-in items (Jonas/Marissa)
4) 5m — immediate next actions / calendar invites

What we need from you before kickoff (if possible)
- Confirm which slot works or propose alternatives
- Share a redacted sample of ~20 notes (or a schema + 2 examples) so Ben can tailor the demo prompts (secure upload link below)
- Any must-have success criteria or compliance controls to call out in the kickoff

Attachments & links
- trial-plan-template.xlsx — draft trial timeline, roles, deliverables
- prompt-set-sample.md — starter prompts and evaluation rubric
- Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/jonas-demo-30m
- Shared Drive (trial materials): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-trial-materials

If it helps, I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a time. Ben will lead the technical portion, Marissa will own commercial/contract items and onboarding logistics.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Dr. Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@novamed.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed demo slots and evaluation kickoff materials

Thanks Jonas — great recap. We’d like to lock the kickoff for Tue, Oct 27 at 2:00pm ET. That time works best for SRE/ML Ops and myself.

I’ll upload 20 redacted notes to the Drive link you provided by EOD Monday (I’ll label them NOVAMED_SAMPLE_01..20). Please confirm secure permissions so only the Redwood trial team can access.

Success criteria we care about (short list):
- Entity extraction: >85% precision on ICD/CPT references
- Summary usefulness: average reviewer rating >= 4/5 across clinical and billing reviewers
- No PHI exfiltration — we need to review retention policy and KMS setup during kickoff

Thanks,
Sita
Dr. Sita Rao
Head of Clinical Informatics, NovaMed
sita.rao@novamed.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@novamed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed demo slots and evaluation kickoff materials

Perfect — Tue, Oct 27 at 2:00pm ET is booked. I’ll send a calendar invite shortly with dial-in details.

Ben — can you lead the demo and confirm you have access to the Drive folder when Sita drops the sample? Also flag any pre-demo prep you need from them (schema, auth method, sample headers).

Marissa — I’ll include the draft trial-plan-template.xlsx in the invite and indicate proposed owners. We should be ready to call out retention/KMS items up front to satisfy Sita’s security ask.

Action items assigned:
- Sita: upload sample notes to shared Drive (by Mon EOD)
- Ben: review sample prompts and confirm demo flow (by Mon COB)
- Marissa/Jonas: finalize trial timeline & invite attendees (by Mon EOD)

Thanks — sending the invite now.

—
Jonas

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed demo slots and evaluation kickoff materials

Got it — I’ll lead the technical deep dive on Tue. Quick notes for the thread:

- For the demo I’ll build two short flows: (A) entity extraction -> structured JSON; (B) extract + human-readable summary. Will show KV cache and batching impact with ~5–10 doc examples.
- Prefer the sample files be in CSV with a column for free text + metadata columns (record id, source system, date). If they can’t, I can adapt JSON/ndjson.
- I’ll need a short schema and one redacted PHI example to test tokenizer behavior (not the full set) — if Sita can flag sensitive fields that helps configure masking.

I’ll post a quick pre-read (2 slides) in the Drive and verify permissions once Sita confirms upload.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
